items.title: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas acts on Nxt-Infra Trust ₹700 crore institutional placement of units
items.summary: Nxt-Infra Trust has made a issuance of units by way of an institutional placement to institutional investors, for an amount aggregating to ₹700.15 crore. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Nxt-Infra Trust as well as the lead managers NovaaOne Capital Private Limited and Ambit Private Limited on this issuance of units. The capital markets team comprised Janhavi Manohar (Partner), Saksham Khokhar (Senior Associate), Ankesh Kumar (Senior Associate), Associates Molika Agrawal, Sanjana Prasad, Monusha Nambiar, Aryan Pandey and Maria Palamattom. The general corporate team comprising of Ratnadeep Roychowdhury (Partner) and Shaunak Choudhury (Associate) also advised on certain aspects of the transaction. Nxt-Infra Sponsored by Actis Highway Infra Limited, Nxt-Infra Trust is an InvIT that owns and operates road and highway assets across India. Its portfolio contains six project SPVs covering over 2,000 lane kilometers across Delhi, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, and Maharashtra. items.title: Transgender person moves Kerala High Court alleging denial of entry to Sabarimala
items.summary: The Kerala High Court on Monday sought the State government's response to a plea filed by a transgender devotee alleging denial of permission to enter Sabarimala temple due to her gender [Sathyashri Sharmila Rehemathali v State of Kerala & ors]. A bench of Justice Gopinath P and Justice S Manu issued notice to the State and posted the matter for further consideration on September 3. Justice Gopinath P and Justice S Manu The petition was filed by Sathyashri Sharmila Rehemathali, who identifies as a transgender woman and claims that she is a devote and a regular pilgrim to Sabarimala. According to the petition, Sharmila reached Pamba on August 20 to get Lord Ayyappa's darshan, after observing the required Vratham and carrying her Irumudi (sacred rituals undertaken by devotees). However, around 3:30 PM, she was stopped during a police inspection near the Pamba Ganapathi Temple and informed that she would not be permitted to proceed uphill because she was a transgender person. As per the petition, officers at the Pamba Police Station told her that the Travancore Devaswom Board had instructed the police not to permit transgender persons to proceed to Sabarimala.
